sql: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reference_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reference_source(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reference_listing(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reference_source(id),name TEXT NOT NULL,condition TEXT NOT NULL,raw_json TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'laptop',price_vnd INTEGER); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reference_offer(listing_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES reference_listing(id),price_vnd INTEGER CHECK(price_vnd>0),observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,url TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reference_fact(listing_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reference_listing(id),key TEXT NOT NULL,value_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(listing_id,key)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reference_price ON reference_offer(price_vnd); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reference_by_source ON reference_listing(source_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reference_by_category ON reference_listing(category); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reference_listing_price ON reference_listing(price_vnd);
